content.title: How to watch Miami (FL) vs. Purdue men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 22
content.text: The No. 2 seed Purdue Boilermakers (28-8) take to the court against the No. 7 seed Miami Hurricanes (26-8) with a Sweet 16 berth on the line on Sunday at Enterprise Center.How to watch Miami Hurricanes vs. Purdue Boilermakers Venue: Enterprise Center Time: 12:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Miami (FL) vs. Purdue odds Spread: Purdue -7.5 (-114), Miami (FL) +7.5 (-106) Favorite Moneyline: Purdue -372 Underdog Moneyline: Miami (FL) +283 Total: 147.5 Total Over Odds: -112 Total Under Odds: -111 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Purdue has a +436 scoring differential, topping opponents by 12.1 points per game. It is putting up 82.3 points per game to rank 48th in college basketball and is allowing 70.2 per outing to rank 73rd in college basketball. Purdue connects on 9.4 three-pointers per game (60th in college basketball) at a 38.5% rate (13th in college basketball), compared to the 8.7 its opponents make while shooting 34.0% from beyond the arc. Miami (FL) outscores opponents by 10.9 points per game (posting 81.9 points per game, 52nd in college basketball, and allowing 71.0 per outing, 98th in college basketball) and has a +369 scoring differential. Miami (FL) hits 6.7 three-pointers per game (283rd in college basketball) while shooting 35.1% from beyond the arc (114th in college basketball). It is making 1.7 fewer threes than its opponents, who drain 8.4 per game at 35.4%.
